description.value: This study investigated the neural correlates of cue exposure with response prevention using fMRI while participants smelled chocolate or a control object and viewed chocolate and neutral pictures.
The experimental design was a mixed design comparing an experimental group with a control group, with repeated measures of brain response across measurement runs.

description.value: The craving subscale of the Attitudes to Chocolate Questionnaire assessed trait preoccupation with chocolate and compulsive behavior elicited by thinking of chocolate. It was administered to characterize participants' trait chocolate craving; it consisted of 10 visual-analog items scored from 0 to 100 and averaged into a craving score.

spans.text: The craving subscale of the Attitudes to Chocolate Questionnaire ( Benton et al. 1998) was used to assess the trait preoccupation with chocolate and the degree of compulsive behavior that is elicited by (thinking of) chocolate.
